name: Gusto
description: Connect Claude to your Gusto account to query and analyze your payroll and people data. Ask questions in natural language, build custom reports, and create charts to uncover trends and insights—no exports or tool-switching required. Eligible customers can also run payroll in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gusto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gusto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.gusto.com/anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gusto MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gusto lists 43 MCP tools, including get_company_onboarding_status, list_employees, record_time, list_payrolls, run_payroll, create_company, list_time_records, list_contractors, list_departments, get_work_address, get_job, and get_location.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gusto?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gusto in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Gusto requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gusto is developed by Gusto. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
